name: Ottawa
tagline: Canada's capital of museums, canals and Parliament
summary: Ottawa is Canada's bilingual capital on the Ottawa River, crowned by the Gothic Revival Parliament buildings. Tour Parliament Hill, visit the National Gallery and Canadian Museum of History, eat a BeaverTail in ByWard Market and skate or cycle the Rideau Canal.
seasonNote: May brings the Tulip Festival; February has Winterlude and canal skating.
arrival: Ottawa Airport is 20 minutes from downtown; trains link Montreal and Toronto.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work everywhere; tip 15 to 20 percent. Sales tax is added at the till.
